prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet – the call for a professional who can design, build, and ship full‑stack applications that embed LLM APIs matches my four years of end‑to‑end system delivery. I regularly present technical designs to business leaders and have delivered projects from concept to production with little guidance.

I built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that turns a business URL into a live, shoppable 3D experience in about a minute. The pipeline runs on Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2 and D1, uses a six‑stage agent flow, and includes a verification stage that blocks unsupported claims. I also created the Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph system that pulls daily job postings via public APIs, scores them with RAG on pgvector, and drafts personalized documents behind a human approval step. Both projects combine React, TypeScript, and serverless edge compute with LLM calls and prompt engineering. In addition, I architected linkme‑intops, a React and TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated interface for managing high‑value subscription accounts and supports data sync with external SaaS tools. I also designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that streamline onboarding of enterprise customers onto core platforms.

One gap in my profile is the lack of documented willingness to travel up to 15 percent. I plan to add travel availability by scheduling quarterly on‑site visits and aligning remote work windows with client timelines.
Thank you for your time; I look forward to speaking soon. I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my full‑stack and AI integration experience can serve Smartsheet’s enterprise customers.
